description: An atmosphere only experiment with fixed Sea Surface Temperatures and Sea Ice Concentrations from pre-industrial (1850) conditions, as in piClim-control, but additionally with fixed Land Surface Temperatures (LSTs) from pre-industrial (1850) conditions. All other forcings should be set to pre-industrial (1850) conditions.  Preserving the diurnal cycle, the LSTs should be prescribed using the 3-hourly temperatures from the standard piClim-control pre-industrial simulation where LSTs freely evolve.
